patient_overview.name: Tyree Fahey
patient_overview.description: Tyree Fahey is a 41-year-old divorced father of five living in Howell, New Jersey, coming in for a nutrition visit tied to his BMI (30.1) and chronic sinusitis. He's full-time employed, cheerful, and quick to crack a joke whenever the conversation turns toward anything that feels like a lecture. He cooks big family-style dinners for his household of six and tends to eat exactly what he serves everyone else, which has made it hard to keep up changes he made a while back. He comes across as agreeable and easygoing, often saying 'whatever you think is best, doc' rather than pushing back, even when he has reservations.

demographics.occupation: Warehouse operations supervisor at a regional distribution center
demographics.cultural_context: Tyree grew up in central New Jersey in a big, loud Italian-American-adjacent household (though his own ethnicity is recorded as White, non-specific) where dinner was the one time everyone had to be at the table. He carried that into his own divorced-dad household: cooking for his kids is how he shows up for them, even on nights he's exhausted from a double shift. He takes pride in being the reliable, fun parent, and uses humor the way some people use silence — to keep things from getting too heavy.
